dogecoin.text:
8/
Bitcoin is not Dogecoin.
It doesn’t worship celebrities.
It doesn’t follow billionaires blindly.
There’s a saying in this space:
 Slay your heroes.
Elon got tested by Bitcoin’s immune system—and rejected.

4/
Instead of addressing the criticism, Musk lashed out emotionally.
When someone pointed out Dogecoin’s centralization, Musk fired back:

“Bitcoin is actually highly centralized, with a supermajority controlled by big mining companies.”

Wrong.

2/
In 2021, Musk was tweeting non-stop about crypto.
Tesla had just bought $1.5B worth of BTC.
He was shilling Dogecoin and criticizing Bitcoin's energy use.

Then Peter McCormack (host of “What Bitcoin Did”) called him out publicly.
